meta.description: Grand Scapes mows, clears leaves, rebuilds beds and plows drives in Linden, MI, a mill town on the Shiawassee with rolling high ground and wet low spots.

hero.kicker: Lawn care, landscaping and snow removal in Linden, MI
hero.title: Wet lawns mowed **without ruts.**
hero.lede: Grand Scapes mows, cleans up, rebuilds beds and plows in Linden, the small city on the Shiawassee River. Lots near downtown are older, the ones toward the edges are newer, and plenty of them have low, wet ground.

about.title: Linden ground stays wet in **the low spots.**
body: Much of Linden is low ground. The higher ground rolls, drains well and is sandy in places, with some real slopes, while the low spots are muck that holds water long after a rain. One lot can have both.
Step past the city limits and you are in Fenton Township, where the county plows the roads and the houses spread out.

points.title: Low spots that stay wet
points.body: A lawn on muck can look fine and still rut under a mower, so we read the ground on mowing day and work around a soft corner instead of tracking it up. Low spots are also where a bed with the wrong plants fails first.

points.title: Slopes on the high ground
points.body: The rolling high ground sheds water and dries out first, and bare soil on a slope washes away. A high cut keeps the grass thicker there, and a block or boulder border can hold a bed that keeps sliding toward the walk. That is [landscaping](/landscaping-linden-mi/) work.

points.title: Yard waste runs into December
points.body: Priority Waste picks up city yard waste on Wednesdays from April 1 into early December; in 2026 the last pickup is December 2. Leaves go in paper bags or marked containers of up to 35 gallons, each under 50 pounds, and branches get bundled in lengths of 4 feet or less.

points.title: Cars off the street all winter
points.body: The city's fall newsletter lists no on-street parking from November 1 to March 31, starting at 2:30 in the morning. Check with City Hall for the exact hours. The ban lets the DPW plow the streets curb to curb.

points.title: Ask before you burn
points.body: A burn permit is one of the city's most requested forms. If you are thinking about burning a leaf pile, check the permit terms with City Hall first, or have us haul the leaves off in a [fall cleanup](/leaf-removal-linden-mi/).

logistics.title: How a Linden job runs.
body: Linden is about 25 minutes from our shop on Embury Road, so yards here are booked on a set day each week instead of squeezed in between other stops. Rob drives out for the estimate, walks the yard with you, suggests what it needs and gives you a price.

In the city, the public works crew clears the streets, some of them dirt. Out in Fenton Township the Genesee County Road Commission plows, with subdivision streets last. Either way, our part is your drive and walks, plowed by our own trucks and treated where people walk.

faq.q: Do you work in Linden, MI?
faq.a: Yes. Grand Scapes works in the City of Linden and the Fenton Township lots around it. We do weekly [lawn mowing](/lawn-mowing-linden-mi/), [leaf removal](/leaf-removal-linden-mi/), [landscaping](/landscaping-linden-mi/) and [snow removal](/snow-removal-linden-mi/), and Rob gives free estimates. Call [(810) 990-3040](tel:+18109903040) or [text Rob](sms:+18109903040).

faq.q: When is the last yard waste pickup of the year in Linden?
faq.a: In 2026 it is Wednesday, December 2, the last of the weekly compost pickups by Priority Waste that started April 1. Yard waste goes in paper bags or marked containers up to 35 gallons, each under 50 pounds. The dates change each year, so check the city's trash page for the current calendar.

faq.q: Who clears the streets in Linden?
faq.a: The city's Department of Public Works clears snow and ice from city streets and grades the dirt roads. Roads outside the city in Fenton Township are plowed by the Genesee County Road Commission.

faq.q: Do you take care of the wet, low lots around town?
faq.a: Yes. Much of the city is lowland, with muck in the low spots that stays wet. We mow those lawns when the ground will carry a mower, trim the soft edges by hand when it will not, and can rebuild a waterlogged bed with plants and a layout that suit wet ground.
